effect_mechanism: IPCC assessments state that agroforestry accumulates above-ground carbon at field scale, with below-ground carbon often 25% or more of the gains, and the SRCCL describes large mitigation benefits from increasing carbon sinks in vegetation and soils [ev_carbon_sequestration_ipccar6_4, ev_carbon_sequestration_ipccar6ch5_6, ev_carbon_sequestration_ipccsrccl6_1]. Meta-analyses in sub-Saharan Africa, the humid tropics and Sudano-Sahelian West Africa report more soil organic carbon under agroforestry than under controls or crop monocultures, used here as the soil-carbon component of sequestration potential [ev_soil_organic_carbon_kuyah19_1, ev_soil_organic_carbon_muchane20_1, ev_soil_organic_carbon_felix18_1]. WOCAT practitioner ratings add that FMNR in Kenya sequesters carbon in biomass through increased tree cover and raises soil organic matter, and the Burkina Faso assisted natural regeneration sheet rates a large gain in soil organic matter [ev_carbon_sequestration_wocat_507_2019_emission_of_carbon_and_greenhouse_gases, ev_soil_organic_carbon_wocat_507_2019_soil_organic_matter_below_ground_C, ev_soil_organic_carbon_wocat_1358_2017_soil_organic_matter_below_ground_C].
conditionality: Much of the evidence is assessment-level or cited-secondary (IPCC global technical and economic potentials, modelled per-hectare densities), and two units are project totals with no per-hectare or per-year denominator [ev_carbon_sequestration_ipccar6_1, ev_carbon_sequestration_ipccar6_3, ev_carbon_sequestration_roe21_1, ev_carbon_sequestration_cmscr20_10, ev_carbon_sequestration_wvfmnr19_11]. The pooled magnitude rests on soil organic carbon response ratios, a component of sequestration rather than a sequestration rate, and the IPCC itself notes that regional estimates are scant and agroforestry options differ by geography [ev_soil_organic_carbon_kuyah19_1, ev_soil_organic_carbon_muchane20_1, ev_carbon_sequestration_ipccar6_7]. The WOCAT units are compiler judgements on documented technology sheets, not measured stocks or rates [ev_carbon_sequestration_wocat_507_2019_emission_of_carbon_and_greenhouse_gases, ev_soil_organic_carbon_wocat_1358_2017_soil_organic_matter_below_ground_C].

effect_mechanism: Household income, economic return and food security are used as proxies for rural poverty [ev_household_income_castle21s_1, ev_economic_return_faosen24_15, ev_food_security_castle21s_1]. Positive results include Senegalese FMNR households earning more from non-timber products than non-adopters, calliandra fodder raising dairy farmers' net income in Kenya and Uganda, Vi Agroforestry advice raising Kenyan dietary diversity, and a windbreak hedge in Senegalese irrigated rice with an internal rate of return of 36 per cent [ev_household_income_seghieri19_12, ev_household_income_kiptot11_1, ev_food_security_castle21s_1, ev_economic_return_faosen24_15]. WOCAT practitioner ratings for FMNR in Kenya and assisted natural regeneration in Burkina Faso record higher farm income and food security, the Kenyan compiler crediting new income from wood, honey, medicinal and other non-wood products and more diversified livelihoods that reduce the risk of food insecurity [ev_household_income_wocat_507_2019_farm_income, ev_household_income_wocat_1358_2017_farm_income, ev_food_security_wocat_507_2019_food_security_selfsufficiency, ev_food_security_wocat_1358_2017_food_security_selfsufficiency]. Both sheets also rate the long-term returns on establishment and maintenance costs as positive to very positive [ev_economic_return_wocat_1358_2017_costbenefit_establishment_long, ev_economic_return_wocat_507_2019_costbenefit_maintenance_long].
conditionality: Results are mixed: a systematic review's pooled income effect is small and not statistically significant, crop–fruit tree intercropping in China lowered gross household income, silvopasture income lags traditional pasture in the first years, and Regreening Africa found average tree-product income unchanged [ev_household_income_castle21s_1, ev_household_income_castle21s_2, ev_economic_return_diasf08_1, ev_household_income_rgaf23_6].
